title: Hybrid Deployment Request Signal Normalization and Risk Taxonomy
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable intake pipeline that normalizes heterogeneous enterprise requests for Private / VPC / on-prem deployments into a fixed signal model, attach a risk taxonomy & numeric score, and route requests into deterministic engagement lanes (self-serve, care-assisted, concierge). Goal: reduce manual triage time and make prioritization defensible for network/upgrade/air-gap constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Normalized intake schema v1 published (fields: network_topology, proxy_type, outbound_allowlist_status, maintenance_window_availability, patch_policy, KMS/HSM constraints, compliance_flags, customer_risk_notes)
Risk taxonomy defined with 4 buckets (Low/Medium/High/Critical) and a tunable numeric scoring function documented
Router mapping: risk score -> engagement lane + SLA + suggested owner automation defined
Preflight probe suggestions and required artifacts checklist generated per lane (packet capture hints, endpoint allowlist template, sample firewall rules)
Console surface: intake form wireframes and follow-up task flow for PM/SE annotated
3 pilot customers (one small SaaS, one mid-market, one regulated enterprise) triaged using the pipeline and feedback recorded
Telemetry events instrumented for time-to-triage and conversion-to-deploy metrics
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff with Solutions Eng, Infra, Security. Aligned on pain: inconsistent signal causing 48-72h triage blocks.
2026-02-18: Draft normalized schema completed by PM; shared with SEs and 2 customer-facing engineers for initial feedback.
2026-02-23: Workshop with Security & Compliance — added KMS/HSM constraint fields and a security_review_required flag to the schema.
2026-03-02: Eng spike approved to prototype the scoring function; estimate 3 points (ENG to deliver prototype endpoints and sample scoring script).
2026-03-08: Design provided intake form wireframes and an inline checklist; requested copy changes to make technical questions more discoverable.
2026-03-12: Pilot onboarding with Acme Analytics (mid-market). Risk score produced: 62 (High). Identified missing proxy topology detail; updated schema to include proxy-delegation-mode.
2026-03-15: Decision to gate concierge lane behind score >= 75 and a positive network smoke test. Assigned follow-up tasks to SE team to build preflight probe playbook.
decisions: Use a hybrid scoring model: weighted rule-based baseline + learning signal (telemetry) for future adjustments
Concierge lane requires a security_review 'true' and a successful preflight smoke test
Store intake artifacts in a per-customer drive link and surface link in the Linear ticket for handoff
Expose risk score and primary failure reasons in the Console intake review pane to make routing decisions transparent to internal users
tradeoffs: Strict schema increases initial friction for customers but reduces back-and-forth — mitigation: progressive disclosure in form (minimal fields then advanced technical fields)
Rule-based scoring is faster to ship but may misclassify edge cases — plan to add a telemetry-driven ML calibrator in Q3
Automating routing reduces manual workload but adds operational complexity for SRE — will keep a manual override with audit trail
next_steps: ENG: deliver scoring prototype endpoint and example scoring job by 2026-03-22
SE: create preflight smoke test checklist and a packet-capture template by 2026-03-29
Design: finalize intake form flow and error states for progressive disclosure by 2026-03-20
PM: schedule pilot window with 2 additional customers and prepare success criteria survey
Comms: draft canned customer replies and SLA expectations for each engagement lane
